title: docs(spec): scrub stale compactLayout teachings + orphaned defaultDetailForm JSDoc (ADR-0085 remnants)
body:
## Summary

Follow-up to the ADR-0085 hand-written docs sweep (#2529). Two stale remnants live in **code** and regenerate into docs, so they survived the docs-only sweep:

1. **`RecordDetailsProps` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`)** — the `layout` and `fields` prop descriptions taught the deprecated `compactLayout` name. Renamed to the ADR-0085 canonical `highlightFields` (`compactLayout` remains a supported alias per the bidirectional mirror in `object.zod.ts`). Regenerated `skills/objectstack-ui/contracts/react-blocks.contract.json` and `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` via `pnpm gen:react-blocks`.
2. **`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`** — removed an orphaned JSDoc block describing `defaultDetailForm`, a prop that was never implemented and was removed from the spec in #2402. The comment had no property attached.

Doc-text only; no schema shape or behavior change. Patch changeset included.

Refs: ADR-0085, #2529, #2402

## Test plan

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` ✅
- spec vitest: 245 files / 6666 tests passed ✅
- `pnpm gen:react-blocks` regenerated contract + reference doc (only the two description strings changed) ✅
